title: Effect Phase Order Logger
problemStatement: Implement `logLifecyclePhases()` that returns an array with the exact execution order of: `'useInsertionEffect'`, `'DOM Mutation'`, `'useLayoutEffect'`, `'Browser Paint'`, and `'useEffect'`.
interviewTrap: `useEffect` is passive and deferred until after paint. `useLayoutEffect` blocks painting.

testCases.name: useLayoutEffect runs before Browser Paint
testCases.testFn: const p = logLifecyclePhases(); return p.indexOf('useLayoutEffect') < p.indexOf('Browser Paint');

testCases.name: useEffect runs strictly after Browser Paint
testCases.testFn: const p = logLifecyclePhases(); return p.indexOf('useEffect') > p.indexOf('Browser Paint');

details.name: useEffect runs strictly after Browser Paint

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: React provides three distinct effect hooks that run at different stages of the commit phase: `useInsertionEffect` (runs first, synchronously before DOM mutations for CSS-in-JS libraries), `useLayoutEffect` (runs second, synchronously after DOM mutations before browser paint), and `useEffect` (runs third, asynchronously after browser paint).
stepByStepWalkthrough: Construct an Effect Phase Order Logger that executes simulated components.
Log each lifecycle step: Render -> Insertion Effects -> DOM Mutated -> Layout Effects -> Browser Paint -> Passive Effects.
Demonstrate that `useInsertionEffect` executes first, then `useLayoutEffect`, and finally `useEffect` asynchronously.
Verify cleanup execution order during unmounts and updates.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals: In `ReactFiberCommitWork.js`, `commitMutationEffects` mutates the DOM. Immediately prior, `commitInsertionEffectOnFiber` fires `useInsertionEffect`. Immediately following, `commitLayoutEffects` fires `useLayoutEffect`. Then control yields to the browser paint engine. After paint, `flushPassiveEffects` drains `useEffect` queues.

complexity.time: O(E) where E is total count of effects across components.

edgeCasesHandled: Strict lifecycle sequence verification across all 3 hook types.
Effect cleanups run prior to re-execution in corresponding phases.
Passive effects defer execution until after paint.

specifications: React Official Docs: Synchronizing with Effects vs Layout Effects vs Insertion Effects
verifiedRules: useInsertionEffect runs synchronously before DOM mutations.
useLayoutEffect runs synchronously after DOM mutations and blocks paint.
useEffect runs asynchronously after browser paint.
